scope: Selected source-bound application and website measurements. Each result retains its actual source, inputs and available provenance; this catalogue is not a new run on the published release or current development source.

bootstrap_dropdown_transition_detail.measurement_scope: Unchanged pinned Bootstrap 5.3.9 / Popper 2.11.8 App: trusted open, Amber selection and close, paired DOM/pixels and responsive cards pass at both widths.

bootstrap_progress_and_layout.result: At 25 and 75 percent the entire 240 by 16 pixel meter matches the literal control. The trusted click grows the fill from 60 to 180 pixels.
bootstrap_progress_and_layout.caption_fix_result: At both widths the automatic caption occupies one 105 by 24 pixel line. Both 220 by 64 pixel crops match the explicit twin. The constrained control still wraps.
bootstrap_progress_and_layout.implicit_grid_result: The two 160 by 40 action links and their 8 and 16 pixel row gaps match both control crops. A trusted click reaches the second link.

separate_alignment_observations.earlier_result: A fixed 64 pixel link in a 192 pixel column stays at the start for center and end alignment. The initial paint matches the reported geometry, and the trusted click reaches the link at its painted location.
separate_alignment_observations.later_result: The focused grid fixture places start, center and end actions at their expected painted and clickable positions.
separate_alignment_observations.limits: Authored grid tracks and RTL alignment remain open. These are distinct fixtures, not a new run of the earlier Bootstrap workflow.

web_animation_midpoints.color: At 500 ms all 576 animated pixels match the literal #6080a0 swatch. All five sampled stages pass.
web_animation_midpoints.next_lite_opacity: At 0, 500 and 1000 ms the 3456-pixel tile paints #ffffff, #808080 and #010101. The edited input, overlap and exterior pixels pass.

vue_runtime_interaction.controls: All 17 original actions completed. Five paired captures and the retained final frame were fault-free. The neighboring input retained its edited value and original default.

async_function_and_arrow.result: Both pages painted the pending, fulfilled and caught states. They retained the rejection identity through the later handler after one intentional unhandled rejection.
async_function_and_arrow.regressions: Vue 3.5.45 retained mounted edits, clicks and timer updates. Vue 2.7.16 and Bootstrap 5.3.9 passed their existing two-width workflows.

original_integration_fixtures.scope: Selected recorded original application fixtures; separate from deployed-polyfill, live-site and physical-device acceptance.

selected_component_path.result: Original App composition exercises nested inert ownership, attribute preparation/import, styles, author/native ARIA forwarding, observer/Promise jobs, icons, events, focus, typing and a native link.
